It brings together the product families assigned to Media, providing the starting point for classification throughout this branch of the catalog. Choose Media when the product’s primary purpose fits this classification path. Compare its position with adjacent categories under Media before assigning a product, using the product’s actual function rather than a promotional name. Where an immediate branch describes the product more precisely, follow that branch and continue to the most appropriate specific category.
